The '''Durasteel Smeltworks''' was a section of the [[Labor Valley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in the [[Galactic War]], the region was heavily bombed, destroying most of the factories in the Smeltworks.<ref name="TOR" />
